summary_en: This study tests mRNA-2808 in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. The study is a Phase 1/2 trial, and the drug is given intravenously or subcutaneously; how long or how often is not stated. The study measures safety and tolerability, which is the stated purpose of the trial.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa mRNA-2808 en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario. Es un estudio de fase 1/2, y el medicamento se administra por vía intravenosa o subcutánea; la duración o la frecuencia no están indicadas. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, que es el propósito indicado del ensayo.
who_for: Prior treatment with a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulatory drug, and an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody.
Measurable disease by serum or urine M-protein, free light chain, plasmacytoma, or bone marrow plasma cells.
not_for: Myeloma involving the central nervous system, or signs of it.
Active plasma cell leukemia, with 20% or more plasma cells in the blood.
Radiotherapy or chemotherapy within 2 weeks before baseline; limited palliative radiotherapy may be allowed after discussion with the sponsor.
Certain antibody therapies within 21 days, or a proteasome inhibitor or immunomodulator within 14 days, before baseline.
Recent stem cell transplant, cell therapy, or high-dose corticosteroids within the windows stated in the record.
